$comment: Capability taxonomy. Keep it small (currently 28). Every evidence entry claims capabilities from this list with a per-capability strength. Adding a capability here is a deliberate act — it should be backed by at least one 'strong' claim somewhere in src/data.

capabilities.label: Creative Direction
capabilities.note: Setting the idea and holding it through execution — with agencies, directors, builders.

capabilities.label: Brand
capabilities.note: Identity systems, brand DNA, the visual and verbal texture of a thing.

capabilities.label: Storytelling
capabilities.note: Deciding whose story it is and what it is really about.

capabilities.label: Film / Production
capabilities.note: Producing and creative-partnering with directors and crews. Not cinematography, not editing.

capabilities.label: Interactive
capabilities.note: Experiences where the input is a voice, a face, a drawn line, or every phone in the room.

capabilities.label: 0→1 Product
capabilities.note: From ambiguity to something tangible enough to test.

capabilities.label: Design Systems
capabilities.note: Including design systems expressed as code.

capabilities.label: Operations
capabilities.note: Running the thing: people, flow, budget, yearly iteration.

capabilities.label: AI
capabilities.note: Designing, building and deploying AI systems — including inside locked-down enterprises.

capabilities.label: Agentic UX
capabilities.note: How people and AI agents share the work.

capabilities.label: Prototyping
capabilities.note: Live-coded, playable, in front of real stakeholders.

capabilities.label: External Partner Direction
capabilities.note: Directing agencies, directors, vendors and volunteers.
